# The Mathematical Model
This document provides a complex number based mathematical model.
## Sets and Parameters
### Sets

$$
\begin{aligned}
& N \text{ : buses} \\
& R \text{ : reference buses} \\
& E, E^R \text{ : branches, forward and reverse orientation} \\
& G, G_i \text{ : generators and generators at bus } i \\
& L, L_i \text{ : loads and loads at bus } i \\
& S, S_i \text{ : shunts and shunts at bus } i \\
\end{aligned}
$$

### Parameters

$$
\begin{aligned}
& S^{gl}_k, S^{gu}_k \quad \forall k \in G  \text{ : generator complex power bounds} \\
& c_{2k}, c_{1k}, c_{0k} \quad \forall k \in G \text{ : generator cost components} \\
& v^l_i, v^u_i \quad \forall i \in N \text{ : voltage bounds} \\
& S^d_k \quad \forall k \in L \text{ : load complex power consumption} \\
& Y^s_k \quad \forall k \in S \text{ : bus shunt admittance} \\
& Y_{ij}, Y^c_{ij}, Y^c_{ji} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ : branch }\pi\text{-section parameters} \\
& T_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ :  branch complex transformation ratio} \\
& s^u_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ : branch apparent power limit} \\
& i^u_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ : branch current limit} \\
& \theta^{\Delta l}_{ij}, \theta^{\Delta u}_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ : branch voltage angle difference bounds}
\end{aligned}
$$


## Mathmatical Model

A complete mathematical model is as follows,
### Variables
$$
\begin{aligned}
& S^g_k \quad \forall k\in G  \text{ : generator complex power dispatch} \\
& V_i \quad \forall i\in N  \text{ : bus complex voltage} \\
& S_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \cup E^R \text{ : branch complex power flow} \\
\\
\end{aligned}
$$

### Formulation
$$
\begin{aligned}
\text{minimize:} &  
\sum_{k \in G} c_{2k} (\Re(S^g_k))^2 + c_{1k}\Re(S^g_k) + c_{0k} \\

\text{subject to:} & \\
& \angle V_{r} = 0 \quad \forall r \in R \\
& S^{gl}_k \leq S^g_k \leq S^{gu}_k \quad \forall k \in G \\
& v^l_i \leq |V_i| \leq v^u_i \quad \forall i \in N \\
& \sum_{k \in G_i} S^g_k - \sum_{k \in L_i} S^d_k - \sum_{k \in S_i} (Y^s_k)^* |V_i|^2 = \sum_{(i,j)\in E_i \cup E_i^R} S_{ij} \quad \forall i\in N \\
& S_{ij} = (Y_{ij} + Y^c_{ij})^* \frac{|V_i|^2}{|T_{ij}|^2} - Y^*_{ij} \frac{V_i V^*_j}{T_{ij}} \quad \forall (i,j)\in E \\
& S_{ji} = (Y_{ij} + Y^c_{ji})^* |V_j|^2 - Y^*_{ij} \frac{V^*_i V_j}{T^*_{ij}} \quad \forall (i,j)\in E \\
& |S_{ij}| \leq s^u_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \cup E^R \\
& |S_{ij}| \leq |V_i| i^u_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \cup E^R \\
& \theta^{\Delta l}_{ij} \leq \angle (V_i V^*_j) \leq \theta^{\Delta u}_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E
\end{aligned}
$$

"""
AC Optimal Power Flow Solver
Implements the mathematical model from math-model.md using complex number formulation
"""

import json
import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import minimize
import sys

# Load network data
with open('network.json', 'r') as f:
    network = json.load(f)

gen_cols = col_info['gen']
branch_cols = col_info['branch']
gencost_cols = col_info['gencost']

gen_data = np.array(network['gen'])
branch_data = np.array(network['branch'])
gencost_data = np.array(network['gencost'])

n_gen = len(gen_data)
n_branch = len(branch_data)

print(f"Network has {n_bus} buses, {n_gen} generators, {n_branch} branches")

# Build bus index mapping (bus number to index)
bus_num_to_idx = {int(bus_data[i, 0]): i for i in range(n_bus)}

qd_bus = bus_data[:, 3] / baseMVA  # Load Q (p.u.)
gs_bus = bus_data[:, 4] / baseMVA  # Shunt conductance (p.u.)
bs_bus = bus_data[:, 5] / baseMVA  # Shunt susceptance (p.u.)
vm_init = bus_data[:, 7]  # Initial voltage magnitude
va_init = bus_data[:, 8] * np.pi / 180  # Initial voltage angle (rad)
vm_min = bus_data[:, 12]  # Min voltage
vm_max = bus_data[:, 11]  # Max voltage

pg_init = gen_data[:, 1] / baseMVA  # Active power (p.u.)
qg_init = gen_data[:, 2] / baseMVA  # Reactive power (p.u.)
qg_max = gen_data[:, 3] / baseMVA  # Max reactive power
qg_min = gen_data[:, 4] / baseMVA  # Min reactive power
vg_setpoint = gen_data[:, 5]  # Voltage setpoint
pg_max = gen_data[:, 8] / baseMVA  # Max active power
pg_min = gen_data[:, 9] / baseMVA  # Min active power
gen_status = gen_data[:, 7].astype(int)  # 1=on, 0=off

# Extract generator cost data
cost_model = gencost_data[:, 0].astype(int)  # 1=piecewise linear, 2=polynomial
cost_ncost = gencost_data[:, 3].astype(int)
# For polynomial model (model=2), coefficients are: c2*P^2 + c1*P + c0
c2 = np.zeros(n_gen)
c1 = np.zeros(n_gen)
c0 = np.zeros(n_gen)

for i in range(n_gen):
    if cost_model[i] == 2:  # Polynomial
        ncost = int(cost_ncost[i])
        if ncost == 3:  # Quadratic
            c2[i] = gencost_data[i, 4]  # coefficient for P^2
            c1[i] = gencost_data[i, 5]  # coefficient for P
            c0[i] = gencost_data[i, 6]  # constant
        elif ncost == 2:  # Linear
            c1[i] = gencost_data[i, 4]
            c0[i] = gencost_data[i, 5]
        elif ncost == 1:  # Constant
            c0[i] = gencost_data[i, 4]

# Extract branch data
f_bus_num = branch_data[:, 0].astype(int)
t_bus_num = branch_data[:, 1].astype(int)
f_bus_idx = np.array([bus_num_to_idx[num] for num in f_bus_num])
t_bus_idx = np.array([bus_num_to_idx[num] for num in t_bus_num])

r_branch = branch_data[:, 2]  # Resistance (p.u.)
x_branch = branch_data[:, 3]  # Reactance (p.u.)
b_branch = branch_data[:, 4]  # Total line charging susceptance (p.u.)
rate_a = branch_data[:, 5] / baseMVA  # MVA rating (p.u.)
tap_ratio = branch_data[:, 8]  # Transformer tap ratio
shift_angle = branch_data[:, 9] * np.pi / 180  # Transformer phase shift (rad)
branch_status = branch_data[:, 10].astype(int)

# Transformer complex ratio

    j = t_bus_idx[k]

    bc_ij = bc_half[k]
    t_ij = t_ratio[k]

    # Add to admittance matrix (pi-model)
    Y_bus[i, i] += (y_ij + bc_ij) / (t_ij * np.conj(t_ij))
    Y_bus[j, j] += y_ij + bc_ij
    Y_bus[i, j] += -y_ij / np.conj(t_ij)
    Y_bus[j, i] += -y_ij / t_ij

for i in range(n_bus):
    Y_bus[i, i] += gs_bus[i] + 1j * bs_bus[i]

    return np.concatenate([va, vm, pg, qg])

    pg = x[2*n_bus:2*n_bus+n_gen]
    qg = x[2*n_bus+n_gen:2*n_bus+2*n_gen]
    return va, vm, pg, qg

    """Compute complex power injections at each bus"""
    V = vm * np.exp(1j * va)
    S = V * np.conj(Y_bus @ V)
    return S.real, S.imag

    """Objective function: total generation cost"""
    va, vm, pg, qg = unpack_x(x)
    pg_MW = pg * baseMVA
    cost = np.sum(c2 * pg_MW**2 + c1 * pg_MW + c0)
    return cost

    """Equality constraints: power balance equations"""
    va, vm, pg, qg = unpack_x(x)

    # Compute power injections
    p_calc, q_calc = compute_power_injections(va, vm)

    # Net injection at each bus
    p_net = np.zeros(n_bus)
    q_net = np.zeros(n_bus)

    # Add generator injections
    for i in range(n_gen):
        if gen_status[i] == 1:
            bus_idx = gen_bus_idx[i]
            p_net[bus_idx] += pg[i]
            q_net[bus_idx] += qg[i]

    q_net -= qd_bus

    # Power balance: calculated = net injection
    p_mismatch = p_calc - p_net
    q_mismatch = q_calc - q_net

    # Reference bus angle constraint
    angle_constraint = va[ref_bus]

    return np.concatenate([p_mismatch, q_mismatch, [angle_constraint]])

def constraints_ineq(x):
    """Inequality constraints (formulated as g(x) >= 0)"""
    va, vm, pg, qg = unpack_x(x)

    constraints = []

    # Generator limits: pg_min <= pg <= pg_max
    for i in range(n_gen):
        if gen_status[i] == 1:
            constraints.append(pg[i] - pg_min[i])  # pg >= pg_min
            constraints.append(pg_max[i] - pg[i])  # pg <= pg_max
            constraints.append(qg[i] - qg_min[i])  # qg >= qg_min
            constraints.append(qg_max[i] - qg[i])  # qg <= qg_max

    # Voltage limits: vm_min <= vm <= vm_max
    for i in range(n_bus):
        constraints.append(vm[i] - vm_min[i])  # vm >= vm_min
        constraints.append(vm_max[i] - vm[i])  # vm <= vm_max

    V = vm * np.exp(1j * va)
    for k in range(n_branch):
        if branch_status[k] == 0 or rate_a[k] == 0:
            continue

        i = f_bus_idx[k]
        j = t_bus_idx[k]

        y_ij = y_branch[k]
        bc_ij = bc_half[k]
        t_ij = t_ratio[k]

        # Power flow from i to j
        S_ij = ((y_ij + bc_ij) / (t_ij * np.conj(t_ij))) * V[i] * np.conj(V[i]) - (y_ij / np.conj(t_ij)) * V[i] * np.conj(V[j])

        # Power flow from j to i
        S_ji = (y_ij + bc_ij) * V[j] * np.conj(V[j]) - (y_ij / t_ij) * np.conj(V[i]) * V[j]

        s_ij_mag = np.abs(S_ij)
        s_ji_mag = np.abs(S_ji)

        # Both directions must be within limit
        constraints.append(rate_a[k] - s_ij_mag)
        constraints.append(rate_a[k] - s_ji_mag)

    return np.array(constraints)

# Voltage angles (reference bus is fixed via equality constraint)
for i in range(n_bus):
    bounds.append((-np.pi, np.pi))

# Voltage magnitudes
for i in range(n_bus):
    bounds.append((vm_min[i], vm_max[i]))

# Generator active power
for i in range(n_gen):
    if gen_status[i] == 1:
        bounds.append((pg_min[i], pg_max[i]))
    else:
        bounds.append((0, 0))

# Generator reactive power
for i in range(n_gen):
    if gen_status[i] == 1:
        bounds.append((qg_min[i], qg_max[i]))
    else:
        bounds.append((0, 0))

    {'type': 'eq', 'fun': constraints_eq},
    {'type': 'ineq', 'fun': constraints_ineq}
]

print("This may take a few minutes for large networks...")

result = minimize(
    objective,
    x0,
    method='SLSQP',
    bounds=bounds,
    constraints=constraints_list,
    options={'maxiter': 1000, 'ftol': 1e-6, 'disp': True}
)

print(f"Success: {result.success}")
print(f"Objective value: ${result.fun:,.2f}/hour")

# Extract solution
va_sol, vm_sol, pg_sol, qg_sol = unpack_x(result.x)

# Convert to degrees
va_deg = va_sol * 180 / np.pi

# Convert to MW/MVAr
pg_MW = pg_sol * baseMVA
qg_MW = qg_sol * baseMVA

# Calculate power flows and losses
V_sol = vm_sol * np.exp(1j * va_sol)
p_calc, q_calc = compute_power_injections(va_sol, vm_sol)

# Total generation
total_gen_p = np.sum(pg_MW[gen_status == 1])
total_gen_q = np.sum(qg_MW[gen_status == 1])

# Total load
total_load_p = np.sum(pd_bus) * baseMVA
total_load_q = np.sum(qd_bus) * baseMVA

# Total losses
total_loss_p = total_gen_p - total_load_p
total_loss_q = total_gen_q - total_load_q

# Calculate branch flows and loading
branch_flows = []
for k in range(n_branch):
    if branch_status[k] == 0:
        continue

    i = f_bus_idx[k]
    j = t_bus_idx[k]

    y_ij = y_branch[k]
    bc_ij = bc_half[k]
    t_ij = t_ratio[k]

    S_ij = ((y_ij + bc_ij) / (t_ij * np.conj(t_ij))) * V_sol[i] * np.conj(V_sol[i]) - (y_ij / np.conj(t_ij)) * V_sol[i] * np.conj(V_sol[j])

    # Power flow from j to i
    S_ji = (y_ij + bc_ij) * V_sol[j] * np.conj(V_sol[j]) - (y_ij / t_ij) * np.conj(V_sol[i]) * V_sol[j]

    s_ji_mag = np.abs(S_ji) * baseMVA
    limit_MVA = rate_a[k] * baseMVA

    if limit_MVA > 0:
        loading_pct = max(s_ij_mag, s_ji_mag) / limit_MVA * 100
    else:
        loading_pct = 0

    branch_flows.append({
        'from_bus': int(f_bus_num[k]),
        'to_bus': int(t_bus_num[k]),
        'loading_pct': loading_pct,
        'flow_from_MVA': s_ij_mag,
        'flow_to_MVA': s_ji_mag,
        'limit_MVA': limit_MVA
    })

# Sort by loading and get top 10
branch_flows_sorted = sorted(branch_flows, key=lambda x: x['loading_pct'], reverse=True)
most_loaded = branch_flows_sorted[:10]

eq_constraints = constraints_eq(result.x)
p_mismatch = eq_constraints[:n_bus]
q_mismatch = eq_constraints[n_bus:2*n_bus]

max_q_mismatch = np.max(np.abs(q_mismatch)) * baseMVA

    elif vm_sol[i] > vm_max[i]:
        v_violations.append(vm_sol[i] - vm_max[i])

        overload_to = max(0, bf['flow_to_MVA'] - bf['limit_MVA'])

        "total_load_MW": float(total_load_p),
        "total_load_MVAr": float(total_load_q),
        "total_generation_MW": float(total_gen_p),

    }

# Add generator data

    if gen_status[i] == 1:
        report["generators"].append({
            "id": int(i + 1),
            "bus": int(gen_bus_num[i]),
            "pg_MW": float(pg_MW[i]),
            "qg_MVAr": float(qg_MW[i]),
            "pmin_MW": float(pg_min[i] * baseMVA),

            "qmin_MVAr": float(qg_min[i] * baseMVA),
            "qmax_MVAr": float(qg_max[i] * baseMVA)
        })

# Add bus data

    report["buses"].append({
        "id": int(bus_data[i, 0]),
        "vm_pu": float(vm_sol[i]),
        "va_deg": float(va_deg[i]),
        "vmin_pu": float(vm_min[i]),
        "vmax_pu": float(vm_max[i])
    })

# Write report
with open('report.json', 'w') as f:
    json.dump(report, f, indent=2)

print(f"\n{'='*60}")
print("SOLUTION SUMMARY")
print(f"{'='*60}")
print(f"Total Cost:        ${result.fun:,.2f}/hour")
print(f"Total Generation:  {total_gen_p:,.2f} MW, {total_gen_q:,.2f} MVAr")
print(f"Total Load:        {total_load_p:,.2f} MW, {total_load_q:,.2f} MVAr")
print(f"Total Losses:      {total_loss_p:,.2f} MW ({total_loss_p/total_gen_p*100:.2f}%)")
print(f"\nFeasibility Metrics:")

print(f"  Max Q mismatch:     {max_q_mismatch:.6f} MVAr")
print(f"  Max V violation:    {max_v_violation:.6f} pu")

Y_bus = np.zeros((n_bus, n_bus), dtype=complex)

for k in range(n_branch):
    if branch_status[k] == 0:
        continue

    i = f_bus_idx[k]
    j = t_bus_idx[k]

    y_ij = y_branch[k]
    bc_ij = bc_half[k]
    t_ij = t_ratio[k]

    # Add to admittance matrix (pi-model)
    Y_bus[i, i] += (y_ij + bc_ij) / (t_ij * np.conj(t_ij))
    Y_bus[j, j] += y_ij + bc_ij
    Y_bus[i, j] += -y_ij / np.conj(t_ij)
    Y_bus[j, i] += -y_ij / t_ij

# Add shunt admittances
for i in range(n_bus):
    Y_bus[i, i] += gs_bus[i] + 1j * bs_bus[i]

# Find reference bus (slack bus)
ref_bus = np.where(bus_type == 3)[0]
if len(ref_bus) == 0:
    ref_bus = [0]  # Default to first bus
else:
    ref_bus = ref_bus[0]

print(f"Reference bus index: {ref_bus}")

# Decision variables: [va (angles), vm (magnitudes), pg (gen P), qg (gen Q)]
# We'll use polar coordinates for voltages

def pack_x(va, vm, pg, qg):
    """Pack variables into a single vector"""
    return np.concatenate([va, vm, pg, qg])

def unpack_x(x):
    """Unpack variables from vector"""
    va = x[:n_bus]
    vm = x[n_bus:2*n_bus]
    pg = x[2*n_bus:2*n_bus+n_gen]
    qg = x[2*n_bus+n_gen:2*n_bus+2*n_gen]
    return va, vm, pg, qg

def compute_power_injections(va, vm):
    """Compute complex power injections at each bus"""
    V = vm * np.exp(1j * va)
    S = V * np.conj(Y_bus @ V)
    return S.real, S.imag

def objective(x):
    """Objective function: total generation cost"""
    va, vm, pg, qg = unpack_x(x)
    pg_MW = pg * baseMVA
    cost = np.sum(c2 * pg_MW**2 + c1 * pg_MW + c0)
    return cost

def constraints_eq(x):
    """Equality constraints: power balance equations"""
    va, vm, pg, qg = unpack_x(x)

    # Compute power injections
    p_calc, q_calc = compute_power_injections(va, vm)

    # Net injection at each bus
    p_net = np.zeros(n_bus)
    q_net = np.zeros(n_bus)

    # Add generator injections
    for i in range(n_gen):
        if gen_status[i] == 1:
            bus_idx = gen_bus_idx[i]
            p_net[bus_idx] += pg[i]
            q_net[bus_idx] += qg[i]

    # Subtract loads
    p_net -= pd_bus
    q_net -= qd_bus

    # Power balance: calculated = net injection
    p_mismatch = p_calc - p_net
    q_mismatch = q_calc - q_net

    # Reference bus angle constraint
    angle_constraint = va[ref_bus]

    return np.concatenate([p_mismatch, q_mismatch, [angle_constraint]])

def constraints_ineq(x):
    """Inequality constraints (formulated as g(x) >= 0)"""
    va, vm, pg, qg = unpack_x(x)

    constraints = []

    # Generator limits: pg_min <= pg <= pg_max
    for i in range(n_gen):
        if gen_status[i] == 1:
            constraints.append(pg[i] - pg_min[i])  # pg >= pg_min
            constraints.append(pg_max[i] - pg[i])  # pg <= pg_max
            constraints.append(qg[i] - qg_min[i])  # qg >= qg_min
            constraints.append(qg_max[i] - qg[i])  # qg <= qg_max

    # Voltage limits: vm_min <= vm <= vm_max
    for i in range(n_bus):
        constraints.append(vm[i] - vm_min[i])  # vm >= vm_min
        constraints.append(vm_max[i] - vm[i])  # vm <= vm_max

    # Branch flow limits
    V = vm * np.exp(1j * va)
    for k in range(n_branch):
        if branch_status[k] == 0 or rate_a[k] == 0:
            continue

        i = f_bus_idx[k]
        j = t_bus_idx[k]

        y_ij = y_branch[k]
        bc_ij = bc_half[k]
        t_ij = t_ratio[k]

        # Power flow from i to j
        S_ij = ((y_ij + bc_ij) / (t_ij * np.conj(t_ij))) * V[i] * np.conj(V[i]) - (y_ij / np.conj(t_ij)) * V[i] * np.conj(V[j])

        # Power flow from j to i
        S_ji = (y_ij + bc_ij) * V[j] * np.conj(V[j]) - (y_ij / t_ij) * np.conj(V[i]) * V[j]

        s_ij_mag = np.abs(S_ij)
        s_ji_mag = np.abs(S_ji)

        # Both directions must be within limit
        constraints.append(rate_a[k] - s_ij_mag)
        constraints.append(rate_a[k] - s_ji_mag)

    return np.array(constraints)

# Initial guess
x0 = pack_x(va_init, vm_init, pg_init, qg_init)

# Bounds
bounds = []
# Voltage angles (reference bus is fixed via equality constraint)
for i in range(n_bus):
    bounds.append((-np.pi, np.pi))

# Voltage magnitudes
for i in range(n_bus):
    bounds.append((vm_min[i], vm_max[i]))

# Generator active power
for i in range(n_gen):
    if gen_status[i] == 1:
        bounds.append((pg_min[i], pg_max[i]))
    else:
        bounds.append((0, 0))

# Generator reactive power
for i in range(n_gen):
    if gen_status[i] == 1:
        bounds.append((qg_min[i], qg_max[i]))
    else:
        bounds.append((0, 0))

# Set up constraints for scipy.optimize
constraints_list = [
    {'type': 'eq', 'fun': constraints_eq},
    {'type': 'ineq', 'fun': constraints_ineq}
]

print("\nSolving AC Optimal Power Flow...")
print("This may take a few minutes for large networks...")

# Use SLSQP method for constrained optimization
result = minimize(
    objective,
    x0,
    method='SLSQP',
    bounds=bounds,
    constraints=constraints_list,
    options={'maxiter': 1000, 'ftol': 1e-6, 'disp': True}
)

print(f"\nOptimization result: {result.message}")
print(f"Success: {result.success}")
print(f"Objective value: ${result.fun:,.2f}/hour")

# Extract solution
va_sol, vm_sol, pg_sol, qg_sol = unpack_x(result.x)

# Convert to degrees
va_deg = va_sol * 180 / np.pi

# Convert to MW/MVAr
pg_MW = pg_sol * baseMVA
qg_MW = qg_sol * baseMVA

# Calculate power flows and losses
V_sol = vm_sol * np.exp(1j * va_sol)
p_calc, q_calc = compute_power_injections(va_sol, vm_sol)

# Total generation
total_gen_p = np.sum(pg_MW[gen_status == 1])
total_gen_q = np.sum(qg_MW[gen_status == 1])

# Total load
total_load_p = np.sum(pd_bus) * baseMVA
total_load_q = np.sum(qd_bus) * baseMVA

# Total losses
total_loss_p = total_gen_p - total_load_p
total_loss_q = total_gen_q - total_load_q

# Calculate branch flows and loading
branch_flows = []
for k in range(n_branch):
    if branch_status[k] == 0:
        continue

    i = f_bus_idx[k]
    j = t_bus_idx[k]

    y_ij = y_branch[k]
    bc_ij = bc_half[k]
    t_ij = t_ratio[k]

    # Power flow from i to j
    S_ij = ((y_ij + bc_ij) / (t_ij * np.conj(t_ij))) * V_sol[i] * np.conj(V_sol[i]) - (y_ij / np.conj(t_ij)) * V_sol[i] * np.conj(V_sol[j])

    # Power flow from j to i
    S_ji = (y_ij + bc_ij) * V_sol[j] * np.conj(V_sol[j]) - (y_ij / t_ij) * np.conj(V_sol[i]) * V_sol[j]

    s_ij_mag = np.abs(S_ij) * baseMVA
    s_ji_mag = np.abs(S_ji) * baseMVA
    limit_MVA = rate_a[k] * baseMVA

    if limit_MVA > 0:
        loading_pct = max(s_ij_mag, s_ji_mag) / limit_MVA * 100
    else:
        loading_pct = 0

    branch_flows.append({
        'from_bus': int(f_bus_num[k]),
        'to_bus': int(t_bus_num[k]),
        'loading_pct': loading_pct,
        'flow_from_MVA': s_ij_mag,
        'flow_to_MVA': s_ji_mag,
        'limit_MVA': limit_MVA
    })

# Sort by loading and get top 10
branch_flows_sorted = sorted(branch_flows, key=lambda x: x['loading_pct'], reverse=True)
most_loaded = branch_flows_sorted[:10]

# Calculate feasibility metrics
eq_constraints = constraints_eq(result.x)
p_mismatch = eq_constraints[:n_bus]
q_mismatch = eq_constraints[n_bus:2*n_bus]

max_p_mismatch = np.max(np.abs(p_mismatch)) * baseMVA
max_q_mismatch = np.max(np.abs(q_mismatch)) * baseMVA

# Voltage violations
v_violations = []
for i in range(n_bus):
    if vm_sol[i] < vm_min[i]:
        v_violations.append(vm_min[i] - vm_sol[i])
    elif vm_sol[i] > vm_max[i]:
        v_violations.append(vm_sol[i] - vm_max[i])

max_v_violation = max(v_violations) if v_violations else 0.0

# Branch overloads
overloads = []
for bf in branch_flows:
    if bf['limit_MVA'] > 0:
        overload_from = max(0, bf['flow_from_MVA'] - bf['limit_MVA'])
        overload_to = max(0, bf['flow_to_MVA'] - bf['limit_MVA'])
        overloads.append(max(overload_from, overload_to))

max_overload = max(overloads) if overloads else 0.0

# Build report
report = {
    "summary": {
        "total_cost_per_hour": float(result.fun),
        "total_load_MW": float(total_load_p),
        "total_load_MVAr": float(total_load_q),
        "total_generation_MW": float(total_gen_p),
        "total_generation_MVAr": float(total_gen_q),
        "total_losses_MW": float(total_loss_p),
        "solver_status": "optimal" if result.success else "failed"
    },
    "generators": [],
    "buses": [],
    "most_loaded_branches": most_loaded,
    "feasibility_check": {
        "max_p_mismatch_MW": float(max_p_mismatch),
        "max_q_mismatch_MVAr": float(max_q_mismatch),
        "max_voltage_violation_pu": float(max_v_violation),
        "max_branch_overload_MVA": float(max_overload)
    }
}

# Add generator data
for i in range(n_gen):
    if gen_status[i] == 1:
        report["generators"].append({
            "id": int(i + 1),
            "bus": int(gen_bus_num[i]),
            "pg_MW": float(pg_MW[i]),
            "qg_MVAr": float(qg_MW[i]),
            "pmin_MW": float(pg_min[i] * baseMVA),
            "pmax_MW": float(pg_max[i] * baseMVA),
            "qmin_MVAr": float(qg_min[i] * baseMVA),
            "qmax_MVAr": float(qg_max[i] * baseMVA)
        })

# Add bus data
for i in range(n_bus):
    report["buses"].append({
        "id": int(bus_data[i, 0]),
        "vm_pu": float(vm_sol[i]),
        "va_deg": float(va_deg[i]),
        "vmin_pu": float(vm_min[i]),
        "vmax_pu": float(vm_max[i])
    })

# Write report
with open('report.json', 'w') as f:
    json.dump(report, f, indent=2)

print(f"\n{'='*60}")
print("SOLUTION SUMMARY")
print(f"{'='*60}")
print(f"Total Cost:        ${result.fun:,.2f}/hour")
print(f"Total Generation:  {total_gen_p:,.2f} MW, {total_gen_q:,.2f} MVAr")
print(f"Total Load:        {total_load_p:,.2f} MW, {total_load_q:,.2f} MVAr")
print(f"Total Losses:      {total_loss_p:,.2f} MW ({total_loss_p/total_gen_p*100:.2f}%)")
print(f"\nFeasibility Metrics:")
print(f"  Max P mismatch:     {max_p_mismatch:.6f} MW")
print(f"  Max Q mismatch:     {max_q_mismatch:.6f} MVAr")
print(f"  Max V violation:    {max_v_violation:.6f} pu")
print(f"  Max branch overload: {max_overload:.2f} MVA")
print(f"\nReport written to report.json")

def compute_power_injections(va, vm):
    """Compute complex power injections at each bus"""
    V = vm * np.exp(1j * va)
    S = V * np.conj(Y_bus @ V)
    return S.real, S.imag

def objective(x):
    """Objective function: total generation cost"""
    va, vm, pg, qg = unpack_x(x)
    pg_MW = pg * baseMVA
    cost = np.sum(c2 * pg_MW**2 + c1 * pg_MW + c0)
    return cost

def constraints_eq(x):
    """Equality constraints: power balance equations"""
    va, vm, pg, qg = unpack_x(x)

    # Compute power injections
    p_calc, q_calc = compute_power_injections(va, vm)

    # Net injection at each bus
    p_net = np.zeros(n_bus)
    q_net = np.zeros(n_bus)

    # Add generator injections
    for i in range(n_gen):
        if gen_status[i] == 1:
            bus_idx = gen_bus_idx[i]
            p_net[bus_idx] += pg[i]
            q_net[bus_idx] += qg[i]

    # Subtract loads
    p_net -= pd_bus
    q_net -= qd_bus

    # Power balance: calculated = net injection
    p_mismatch = p_calc - p_net
    q_mismatch = q_calc - q_net

    })

# Most loaded branches
branch_flows_sorted = sorted(branch_flows, key=lambda x: x['loading_pct'], reverse=True)
most_loaded = branch_flows_sorted[:10]

# Feasibility check
eq_vals = power_balance_constraints(result.x)
p_mismatch = eq_vals[:n_bus]
q_mismatch = eq_vals[n_bus:2*n_bus]

max_p_mismatch = np.max(np.abs(p_mismatch)) * baseMVA
max_q_mismatch = np.max(np.abs(q_mismatch)) * baseMVA

v_violations = np.concatenate([vm_min - vm_sol, vm_sol - vm_max])
max_v_violation = np.max(v_violations[v_violations > 0]) if np.any(v_violations > 0) else 0.0

overloads = []
for bf in branch_flows:
    if bf['limit_MVA'] > 0:
        overload = max(bf['flow_from_MVA'], bf['flow_to_MVA']) - bf['limit_MVA']
        if overload > 0:
            overloads.append(overload)

max_overload = max(overloads) if overloads else 0.0

report = {

        "total_load_MW": float(total_load_p),
        "total_load_MVAr": float(total_load_q),

        "total_losses_MW": float(total_loss_p),
        "solver_status": "optimal" if result.success else "suboptimal"
    },
    "generators": [],
    "buses": [],
    "most_loaded_branches": most_loaded,
    "feasibility_check": {
        "max_p_mismatch_MW": float(max_p_mismatch),
        "max_q_mismatch_MVAr": float(max_q_mismatch),
        "max_voltage_violation_pu": float(max_v_violation),
        "max_branch_overload_MVA": float(max_overload)
    }
}

# Add generators
for i in range(n_gen):
    if gen_status[i] == 1:
        report["generators"].append({
            "id": int(i + 1),
            "bus": int(gen_bus_num[i]),
            "pg_MW": float(pg_MW[i]),
            "qg_MVAr": float(qg_MW[i]),
            "pmin_MW": float(pg_min[i] * baseMVA),
            "pmax_MW": float(pg_max[i] * baseMVA),
            "qmin_MVAr": float(qg_min[i] * baseMVA),
            "qmax_MVAr": float(qg_max[i] * baseMVA)
        })

# Add buses
for i in range(n_bus):
    report["buses"].append({
        "id": int(bus_data[i, 0]),
        "vm_pu": float(vm_sol[i]),
        "va_deg": float(va_deg[i]),
        "vmin_pu": float(vm_min[i]),
        "vmax_pu": float(vm_max[i])
    })

# Write report
with open('report.json', 'w') as f:
    json.dump(report, f, indent=2)

print(f"Total Losses:      {total_loss_p:,.2f} MW ({total_loss_p/total_gen_p*100:.3f}%)")

print(f"  Max Q mismatch:      {max_q_mismatch:.6f} MVAr")

print(f"  Max branch overload: {max_overload:.2f} MVA")
